3.critic_justification: main.dart:89 calls authController.initialize() at startup. initialize (auth_controller.dart:162-168) calls ensureAnonymous(), which calls FirebaseAuth.instance.signInAnonymously() at line 191 when no current user exists, then DdayCloudSync.start(). The same initialize path calls _restoreGoogleAccount() (lines 407-412), which uses GoogleSignIn.signInSilently() and _linkFirebase() (lines 259-293). _linkFirebase signs the Google credential into Firebase and UserProfileSync.upsertCurrentUser() writes users/{uid} with email and displayName (user_profile_sync.dart:17-24). LegalScreen only renders LegalCopy; legal_copy.dart:175 treats install or continued use as agreement, and there is no Accept control before these calls. user_initiated false, first-party Firebase, and missing in-app consent match the code.

5.critic_justification: nickname_dialog.dart:53 calls setNickname from the Save handler. setNickname updates FirebaseAuth displayName (auth_controller.dart:329) and calls UserProfileSync.syncDisplayName (line 362), which writes displayName to users/{uid} and to dday_memberships host and member fields (user_profile_sync.dart:32-71). The hint at app_strings.dart:363-364 says the name is shown to friends. The user taps Save before the upload, so user_initiated true and prominent-disclosure exempt are correct. The off-device Firebase write still has to be declared as Name. The sink is the app's Firebase project, so is_third_party false is correct.

6.critic_justification: The writes that contain a name are user-initiated or a resume of data the user already submitted. TogetherCheerRepository.save (lines 77-95) attaches the nickname only when a cheer is saved. setNickname (auth_controller.dart:322-362) runs from the Save button and then syncDisplayName. DdayCloudSync.start line 50 calls upsertCurrentUser with no displayName argument, so it writes FirebaseAuth currentUser.displayName, which is empty until the user saved a nickname or completed Google sign-in. Restarting that sync from ensureAnonymous or authStateChanges does not collect a new name. legal_copy.dart:113 and :242 already describe storing the nickname for room members, and prominent disclosure is exempt for a name the user types. This is the same collection as finding 5, not a silent first transfer.
